_readme.what: Chest loot tuning. Every item that can appear in chest loot is listed under "items". Set "remove": true to take it out of every chest, or "frequency": 0.5 to make it show up half as often wherever it appears. Then /reload in game. Nothing else to run.

items.remove: true = never appears in any chest loot.
items.frequency: 0..1, multiplies how often the item appears per chest-loot roll, in every table. 1 = unchanged, 0.25 = a quarter as often, 0 = same as remove. Values above 1 are clamped to 1 (use 30_redistribute.js to add or boost loot).
items.chests: Read-only. How many loot tables (roots: the ones containers actually use) can give this item.
items.where: Read-only. Chance (%) that one chest from that table contains at least one of the item, BEFORE tuning, assuming no Luck. Includes sub-tables and mod-injected loot.
items.missing: Set by the generator when an item you edited no longer shows up in any chest table.

_readme.patterns: Bulk rules keyed "@modid" (every item of a mod) or "/regex/" (matched against the item id). Value: {"remove": true} or {"frequency": 0.5}, optional "except": ["ns:id", ...]. An item whose own entry is edited (remove true or frequency != 1) ignores patterns. Tag patterns ("#ns:tag") are not supported: tags are not bound yet while loot tables load.

settings.enabled: false = the whole tuning system does nothing.
settings.slack: "redistribute" (default): the share an item loses goes to the other entries of the same pool, so chests stay as full as before (like deleting the entry in a datapack). "empty": the lost share becomes an empty roll, every other item keeps its exact odds, chests get a bit emptier.
settings.log_tables: true = log one line per rewritten table to logs/kubejs/server.log.

_readme.how: Where the item is a normal entry in a loot table JSON (almost always), its weight is rewritten before the roll. Items that mods inject in code (global loot modifiers, tag entries, pools added in code) are thinned or removed after the roll by LootJS instead: removed stacks leave an empty slot there. Full details: kubejs/server_scripts/loot/README.md.
_readme.regenerate: python3 tools/gen_loot_config.py (after mod updates / a fresh /dumploot). Keeps your edits.
